description: Read-only caption QA against a published standard (default netflix_adult): reading speed, line length and count, durations, gaps, overlaps, line-break grammar, shot changes (cut_times) and an estimated safe area for 9:16. Input: file_path (.srt/.vtt), text, plan_path or cues (e.g. from read_sequence_captions). Local-only; never changes Premiere.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute path of an existing directory the caller approved for file access. transcript_path, plan_path and output paths must be inside it.

baseline_y_pct.description: Where the last line's baseline sits, percent of the frame height. Default: the bottom of the safe area's caption band.

char_width_ratio.description: Average glyph width as a share of the font size (default 0.55; about 0.45 for a condensed face, 0.65 for a wide one).

cues.description: Cues to check, for example the captions read back by read_sequence_captions or a plan's captions. At most 20000. Provide exactly one of file_path, text, plan_path or cues.

end_seconds.description: Out-time in sequence seconds; must be after the in-time.

text.description: Displayed text; separate the lines with a newline.

cut_times.description: Shot changes in sequence seconds, from detect_scene_edits / scene_edit_detection or the sequence's edit points. Captions that straddle or sit close to one are flagged.

items.description: A shot change in sequence seconds.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

file_path.description: Absolute path of a .srt or .vtt file inside approved_workspace_path (realpath-checked, at most 5 MiB). Requires approved_workspace_path. Provide exactly one of file_path, text, plan_path or cues.

font_size_px.description: Caption font size in pixels at that frame, for the safe-area estimate.

format.description: Format of text or file_path. Default: from the file extension, else WEBVTT header means vtt, else srt.

frame.description: Output frame in pixels, for the safe-area estimate.

frame_rate.description: Frames per second of the sequence, for the gap checks. Without it (and without sequence_timebase_ticks) it is inferred from the cue times and the result says frame_rate_inferred.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-chosen key (1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) for this intended edit. Pass a fresh key per edit and reuse it only when retrying that same edit, for example after a client-side timeout. A repeat with the same tool, key and arguments is not run again: while the first call is running it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (poll get_last_operations); after it finished it returns the original outcome marked replayed. A definite failure with nothing applied (receipt outcome not_applied) may be retried with the same key. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scoped to this MCP session (the stdio server process, or the HTTP server process when Streamable HTTP is stateless per request) and held in memory only (200 keys, 1 hour); it does not survive a restart or reconnect. Read-only invocations are never deduplicated.

max_issues.description: Most issues listed (default 200); counts always cover all of them and truncated says whether the list was cut.

plan_path.description: Absolute path of a saved caption plan (.json written by plan_captions) inside approved_workspace_path. Requires approved_workspace_path. Without standard, the plan's own standard is used. Provide exactly one of file_path, text, plan_path or cues.

safe_area.description: Estimate each cue's text box and flag cues outside this safe area. Needs frame and font_size_px. Default when those are given: reels_9_16 for a portrait frame, landscape_16_9 otherwise. Estimates, not measurements.

sequence_timebase_ticks.description: Premiere ticks per frame of the sequence (the timebase from get_sequence_settings; 254016000000 ticks make a second). Converted to a frame rate with the common rates snapped (23.976, 25, 29.97 ...). An error when frame_rate is also given and differs.

standard.description: The standard to check against: netflix_adult (default), netflix_kids, bbc, dcmp or social_9x16.

text.description: SRT or WebVTT text (at most 5 MiB). Provide exactly one of file_path, text, plan_path or cues.

name: check_captions

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.

title: Check Captions
